blocks.source: 日本の昔話をテーマにした物語。ＦＣの桃太郎伝説の続編。実はＰＣエンジンの桃太郎伝説2の大幅リメイクらしいけれど、ラスボスが違うなど、別物といって良いレベルに変更されている模様。
blocks.translation: A story based on Japanese folktales. A sequel to the Famicom's Momotaro Legend. In fact, it seems to be a heavily remade version of Momotaro Legend 2 for the PC Engine, but it has been changed enough to be considered a separate game, including having a different final boss.

blocks.source: 物語はかぐや姫が住む月の宮殿に鬼族の魔の手が忍び寄るところから始まる。助けに向かった桃太郎だったが、鬼族のダイダ王子に全く刃が立たない。力を奪われ地上に落とされた桃太郎は、かぐや姫と世界を救うために、再び立ち上がる。……というのがあらすじ。
blocks.translation: The story begins when the demonic Oni clan's evil influence begins to creep into the lunar palace where Princess Kaguya lives. Momotaro goes to help her, but he is completely outmatched by Prince Daida of the Oni clan. Stripped of his power and cast down to Earth, Momotaro rises once again to save the world and Princess Kaguya. That is the basic premise.

blocks.source: 前作の６年後が舞台。ゲーム開始時点で、既に桃太郎はえんま大王を懲らしめ改心させた英雄となっている。前作に登場した金太郎や浦島太郎も仲間として登場。シリーズおなじみの夜叉姫はここで初登場。父や兄との因縁など、かぐや姫よりもヒロインチックな活躍を見せる。
blocks.translation: The story takes place six years after the previous game. By the beginning of the game, Momotaro has already become a hero who defeated and reformed King Enma. Kintaro and Urashima Taro, who appeared in the previous game, also join the party. The series staple Princess Yasha makes her first appearance here. With her ties to her father and brother, she plays a more heroine-like role than Princess Kaguya.

blocks.source: 子供向けと思われがちだが、実はＳＦＣでも屈指のシナリオだと個人的には思っている。キャラクターは個性的で、１つ１つのイベントにも味がある。地上・月・海底を行き来する物語は冒険感にあふれる。後半の展開も意外にシリアスで、何といってもラスボスはＲＰＧ屈指の悪役として強烈な印象を残す。
blocks.translation: Although it is often thought to be aimed at children, I personally think it is one of the best scenarios on the SNES. The characters are distinctive, and every event has its own charm. The story's journey between the surface, the moon, and the ocean floor is full of a sense of adventure. The developments in the latter half are surprisingly serious, and above all, the final boss leaves a powerful impression as one of the greatest villains in RPGs.

blocks.source: ところで、１０年後に発売したＤＱ８とラストバトルが微妙に似ているけれど、これの影響だろうか。制作者が旧知の友人同士だし、大いにありえそう。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, the last battle bears a slight resemblance to that of Dragon Quest VIII, released ten years later. Could this have been an influence? The creators were longtime friends, so it seems quite possible.

blocks.source: 基本はドラクエ系のオーソドックスなシステムだが、個性も豊か。天気によって状況が変わる戦闘、様々な能力を持った仲間、多彩な特徴を持った敵など、オリジナリティは十分。反面、敵も仲間も個性が強力過ぎて、バランスが崩れている部分も。
blocks.translation: The foundation is a conventional Dragon Quest-style system, but it also has plenty of individuality. Battles whose circumstances change with the weather, party members with various abilities, enemies with a wide range of distinctive traits—the game has plenty of originality. On the other hand, both the enemies and party members are too powerful in their individuality, resulting in some imbalance.

blocks.source: 全体的に敵は強く難易度は高い。それだけではなく嫌らしい特技を持った敵が多いのも困りもの。中には、こちらの所持金を全額盗む、とんでもない敵まで存在する。ただ、味方側も強力な能力を持っている。桃太郎が覚える『鹿角の術』もその１つ。消費は大きいが、敵全体に会心の一撃を与える効果があり、ほとんどのザコ敵はこれ一発で全滅できる。
blocks.translation: The enemies are strong overall, and the difficulty is high. It is also troublesome that many enemies possess nasty Techs. Some are even outrageous enough to steal all of your money. That said, your side also has powerful abilities. One of them is Momotaro's Deer Antler spell. It has a high cost, but it deals a critical hit to all enemies, allowing you to wipe out most weak enemies with a single use.

blocks.source: 段（レベル）が上がると、全回復する便利な仕様も桃太郎伝説から継続。他にも、倒すと味方を全快してくれる敵がいたりして、プレイヤーに対する飴と鞭の構造になっている。総合的には、かなり際どい次元でゲームバランスを取っている。決して万人向けではないのだが、メリハリが効いていてある意味面白い。
blocks.translation: The convenient feature of fully restoring your HP when your dan (level) increases is carried over from Momotaro Legend. There are also enemies that fully restore your party when defeated, creating a carrot-and-stick structure for the player. Overall, the game balance is maintained at a very fine line. It is by no means suited to everyone, but its sharp contrasts make it interesting in a certain way.

blocks.source: このゲームは「面白いけれど操作性の悪い」作品として有名。ここさえもっとまともならば……。
blocks.translation: This game is famous as a title that is "fun but has poor controls." If only this aspect had been more polished...

blocks.source: 全般的にキーの操作が非常に悪く反応が遅い。例えば、メニューを開いて、回復アイテムを使うだけの作業に６秒程度かかる。これは、ＤＱやＦＦなら、２～３秒程度で完了する作業。しかも、その度にメニューを閉じてしまうので、複数回アイテムを使いたい場合はたまらない。
blocks.translation: Key controls are generally very poor, and response times are slow. For example, simply opening the menu and using a healing item takes about six seconds. In Dragon Quest or Final Fantasy, this task would take about two or three seconds. To make matters worse, the menu closes each time, making it extremely frustrating when you want to use multiple items.

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポも遅く、逐一キー入力してメッセージを送らないと、最速にならないのは辛い。オプションで多少メッセージは省略できるがそれでも遅め。ダメージ表示も小さくて見辛い。
blocks.translation: The battle tempo is also slow, and it is painful that you have to press a key to advance each message in order to play at the fastest speed. You can skip some messages through the options, but it is still on the slow side. Damage displays are also small and difficult to read.

blocks.source: イラストがうまくドット絵に変換できている。歩行キャラクターやマップの書き込みは少し物足りないところもあるけど、フロントビューの戦闘画面は中々見栄えがいい。敵のグラフィックも個性豊か。
blocks.translation: The illustrations have been converted into pixel art effectively. The walking characters and map details can feel a little lacking, but the front-view battle screens look quite good. The enemy graphics are also highly distinctive.

blocks.source: ＦＣの桃太郎伝説と同じく、サザンオールスターズの関口和之氏が担当。
blocks.translation: As with the Famicom's Momotaro Legend, the music was composed by Kazuyuki Sekiguchi of the Southern All Stars.

blocks.source: 『フィールド曲』『戦闘曲』など、和風のメロディかつ王道ＲＰＧといった感じで、作品に良く合っている。浦島の村の曲が例の童謡のアレンジだったりするのも面白い。エンディングでＦＣ桃太郎伝説の懐かしい曲が流れる事に感動。
blocks.translation: Songs such as "Field Theme" and "Battle Theme" have Japanese-style melodies with a classic RPG feel, and fit the game very well. It is also amusing that the song for Urashima's village is an arrangement of that familiar children's song. I was moved when the nostalgic music from the Famicom's Momotaro Legend played during the ending.

blocks.source: 『物語』『システム』『美術』『音楽』については、十分に同時期のＤＱに張り合える水準。問題は万人向けとは言い難い難易度と困難な操作性。今はネットで攻略が見れるからよいけれど、当時は途中で挫折する人も多かったのではないかと。
blocks.translation: In terms of its story, systems, art, and music, it was easily on par with the Dragon Quest games of the same period. The problems were its difficulty, which could hardly be called suitable for everyone, and its challenging controls. It is fine now because walkthroughs are available online, but I suspect many people gave up partway through back then.
